questions_before_times: Year, make and model (sets the size)
Pet hair, smoke smell, heavy mud or sand: none, some or heavy, each
Where the car will be: a driveway, a garage, an apartment lot, an office lot or the street
Any HOA, building or office rule about washing cars
safety_stop: Blood, needles or other body fluids in the car: no booking. Rosie says a biohazard cleaning company is the right call, and to call 911 if anyone is hurt.
staff_skills: Interior, exterior, paint polish and ceramic coating, pressure washing. Only detailers with the coating skill are offered for coatings.
messages_never: Gate, garage or lockbox codes, where the keys are, and the license plate. They stay on the secure page.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
